text:
Which statement about electromagnetic induction is correct?
A
A strong magnet that is held stationary near a stationary conductor causes a greater effect
than a weak magnet.
B
The effect occurs when a magnet and a conductor are both moved with the same speed and
in the same direction.
C
The effect occurs when a magnet is moved away from a nearby conductor.
D
The effect only occurs when a magnet is moved towards a conductor.
